description: Lists the FiveM servers the signed-in customer connected under My account (agent pairing) with online state, and the newest install of each product on each server: status (requested, planned = waits for the owner's confirmation in the account, running, succeeded, failed, rolled_back), folder and remaining setup (dependencies, SQL, config). Use it to pick a server_id for install_on_server and to follow an install.
name: list_servers
title: List my connected servers
